text: DSH Remote Gateway 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的远程访问网关，通过反向代理把浏览器请求转发到仅监听本机回环地址的 DSH Web 服务。它支持 HTTP、SSE 与 WebSocket，并针对 DSH 连接模块调整回环能力探测，让远程界面可以正常连接。插件还提供来源 IP 白名单、健康检查接口，以及用 DSH 应用内文件浏览器选择主机工作区的配置。适合需要从远程浏览器访问 DSH Web 界面的用户；运行时需要配置监听地址、端口和允许的来源地址，并由 DSH Web 服务提供上游地址。

DSH Remote Gateway connects a remote browser to a DSH web profile through a reverse proxy. It forwards HTTP, SSE, and WebSocket traffic to DSH's loopback web server and adapts its connection check. Configure its listen address, port, and allowed source IPs; DSH provides the upstream address.
想从外面的浏览器打开家里运行的 DSH Web 界面。
让远程使用时的 DSH 页面也能保持 WebSocket 连接。
I need a gateway that forwards my DSH web app through a reverse proxy, including WebSockets.
DSH Remote Gateway 的功能「转发远程 Web 请求」：将允许来源发来的 HTTP 请求转发到 DSH 本机 Web 服务，并支持 SSE 响应及 WebSocket Upgrade，让远程页面可继续使用实时连接。
DSH Remote Gateway 的功能「远程工作区选择」：配置补丁禁用宿主机原生目录选择器并启用 DSH 应用内浏览器组件，使远程用户能从界面选择 DSH 主机上的工作区。

@jiachi/dsh-remote-gateway README · Introduction：

DSH Remote Gateway

A source-filtered gateway for using DeepSeek Harness through an authenticated reverse proxy.

简体中文 · Security · Compatibility
@jiachi/dsh-remote-gateway README · Introduction：

@jiachi/dsh-remote-gateway README · Why：DSH intentionally keeps privileged browser capabilities on loopback. A normal reverse proxy can render the page remotely while settings, plugin bundles, WebSockets, or host directory selection still fail. This plugin provides a narrow compatibility gateway without exposing the internal DSH web server directly.

@jiachi/dsh-remote-gateway README · Features：- Proxies HTTP, SSE, and WebSocket traffic.
- Accepts requests only from explicitly listed source IP addresses.
- Keeps the internal DSH web server bound to `127.0.0.1`.
- Rewrites the upstream `Host` and `Origin` to the internal loopback authority.
- Strips edge authentication and forwarded-client identity headers before requests enter DSH.
- Patches only the exact `dsh-client-connection` capability probe; every other plugin bundle is passed through byte-for-byte.
- Replaces the host-native directory dialog with DSH's in-app filesystem browser, so remote users can choose a workspace on the DSH host.
- Starts and stops with the DSH plugin lifecycle, so an existing systemd, launchd, or other DSH supervisor also supervises the gateway.

@jiachi/dsh-remote-gateway README · Architecture：The reverse proxy is the public security boundary. It must provide TLS and authentication. The gateway's source allowlist is defense in depth, not user authentication.

@jiachi/dsh-remote-gateway README · Install：Requirements:

- DSH web profile
- Node.js 22.19 or newer
- A reverse proxy that supports WebSocket forwarding and authentication

Install from GitHub:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Jiachi5533/dsh-remote-gateway
```

Then edit the generated `remote-gateway` entry in `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: remote-gateway
  name: '@jiachi/dsh-remote-gateway'
  config:
    host: 0.0.0.0

@jiachi/dsh-remote-gateway README · Install：Restart the DSH web process after the first installation. Configure the reverse proxy to send HTTP and WebSocket traffic to `http://DSH_HOST_LAN_IP:3080`, and enable HTTPS plus authentication at that proxy.

> Never expose port 3080 directly to the internet. Do not add broad network ranges to `allowedSources`; the current implementation accepts exact IP addresses only.

@jiachi/dsh-remote-gateway README · Configuration：| Option | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `host` | `0.0.0.0` | Gateway listen address. |
| `port` | `3080` | Gateway listen port. Use `0` only in tests. |
| `allowedSources` | `['127.0.0.1']` | Exact IPv4 or IPv6 source addresses allowed to connect. |

@jiachi/dsh-remote-gateway README · Configuration：IPv4-mapped addresses are canonicalized, and IPv6 loopback `::1` is treated as `127.0.0.1`. The upstream host and port are obtained from DSH itself and cannot be redirected through plugin configuration. Startup fails if the internal DSH web server is not bound to `127.0.0.1`.

Allowlisted monitoring systems can check `GET /_dsh-remote-gateway/health`. It returns `200 ok` without contacting the DSH upstream, so it verifies the gateway process and source policy rather than DSH readiness.

@jiachi/dsh-remote-gateway README · Security model：- TLS and user authentication terminate at your reverse proxy.
- Only the reverse proxy's LAN address should be allowed at the gateway.
- The internal DSH web server stays loopback-only.
- `Authorization`, `Proxy-Authorization`, `Forwarded`, `X-Forwarded-*`, and `X-Real-IP` are removed before proxying upstream.
- A source-IP allowlist does not protect against a compromised reverse proxy or another device that can use the same source address.
- DSH plugins execute with the DSH process permissions. Review every third-party plugin before installation.
@jiachi/dsh-remote-gateway README · Security model：See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) for reporting and operational guidance.

@jiachi/dsh-remote-gateway README · Compatibility：| Component | Status |
| --- | --- |
| DSH `0.1.1-rc.2` | Verified on 2026-08-28 |
| HTTP and SSE | Verified |
| WebSocket upgrade | Verified |
| Settings API | Verified |
| In-app host directory browser | Verified |
| Existing and future standard Host/Client bundles | Passed through unchanged, except the exact connection module path |

@jiachi/dsh-remote-gateway README · Compatibility：The connection compatibility patch is deliberately fail-closed. If a DSH update changes the expected probe, that module returns `502` with an explicit log message instead of silently loading a partly broken remote UI.

@jiachi/dsh-remote-gateway README · Compatibility：Most well-behaved plugins continue to work because their client assets and same-origin requests are transparently forwarded. A plugin may still need its own remote adaptation if it hard-codes `localhost`, opens a native host dialog, or independently rejects non-loopback browser locations.

@jiachi/dsh-remote-gateway README · Upgrade and removal：Update by re-adding the GitHub source from dsh-market or the CLI, then restart DSH:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Jiachi5533/dsh-remote-gateway
```

Remove it with:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove @jiachi/dsh-remote-gateway
```

After removal, delete any remaining `remote-gateway`, `directory-picker-browse`, and `ui-directory-picker-browse` rows that were added by this plugin from the profile patch, then restart DSH.

@jiachi/dsh-remote-gateway README · Troubleshooting：- `403 forbidden`: the TCP source address is not present in `allowedSources`. Add the reverse proxy's LAN IP, not the remote browser's public IP.
- `502 ... compatibility probe matched 0 times`: the installed DSH client connection module changed. Pin a verified DSH version or open an issue with both version numbers.
- Page loads but WebSocket fails: enable WebSocket upgrade forwarding in the reverse proxy.
- Native folder dialog appears: confirm both browse picker rows in `cordis.patch.yml` are enabled and the native `directory-picker` row is disabled.
- New UI plugin is missing: restart DSH after installing the plugin, then hard-refresh the browser.

@jiachi/dsh-remote-gateway README · Development：```sh
npm test
```

The test suite covers source filtering, IPv4-mapped addresses, trust-header rewriting, fail-closed module patching, and byte-preserving proxy behavior for unrelated plugin bundles.

@jiachi/dsh-remote-gateway README · Introduction：

DSH Remote Gateway

让 DeepSeek Harness 安全地通过带认证的反向代理供远程浏览器使用。

English · 安全模型 · 兼容性
@jiachi/dsh-remote-gateway README · Introduction：
@jiachi/dsh-remote-gateway README · 解决什么问题：DSH 会把高权限浏览器能力限制在回环地址。普通反代可能只能让页面显示出来，设置、插件模块、WebSocket 或宿主机目录选择仍会失败。本插件提供一个范围很窄的兼容网关，同时不把 DSH 内部 Web 服务直接暴露到局域网或公网。

@jiachi/dsh-remote-gateway README · 功能：- 透明转发 HTTP、SSE 和 WebSocket；
- 只接受显式列出的来源 IP；
- 保持 DSH 内部 Web 服务监听在 `127.0.0.1`；
- 将上游 `Host` 和 `Origin` 对齐到内部回环地址；
- 请求进入 DSH 前移除边缘认证和转发客户端身份相关请求头；
- 只修改 `dsh-client-connection` 的精确能力探针，其余插件 bundle 逐字节透传；
- 将宿主机原生目录对话框替换为 DSH 应用内文件浏览器，远程选择 DSH 主机上的工作区；
- 跟随 DSH 插件生命周期启停，现有 systemd、launchd 或其他 DSH 守护方式会同时守护网关。
@jiachi/dsh-remote-gateway README · 架构：反向代理才是公网安全边界，必须提供 TLS 和登录认证。网关的来源白名单只是纵深防御，不是用户认证。

@jiachi/dsh-remote-gateway README · 安装：要求：

- DSH web profile；
- Node.js 22.19 或更高版本；
- 支持 WebSocket 转发和登录认证的反向代理。

从 GitHub 安装：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Jiachi5533/dsh-remote-gateway
```

然后编辑 `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` 中生成的 `remote-gateway` 配置：

```yaml
- id: remote-gateway
  name: '@jiachi/dsh-remote-gateway'
  config:
    host: 0.0.0.0

首次安装后重启 DSH Web 进程。将反向代理的 HTTP 和 WebSocket 上游设置为 `http://DSH主机局域网IP:3080`，并在反向代理上启用 HTTPS 与登录认证。

> 不要把 3080 端口直接暴露到公网，也不要在 `allowedSources` 里配置大范围网段；当前实现只接受准确 IP 地址。

@jiachi/dsh-remote-gateway README · 配置：| 配置项 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `host` | `0.0.0.0` | 网关监听地址。 |
| `port` | `3080` | 网关监听端口；`0` 仅用于测试。 |
| `allowedSources` | `['127.0.0.1']` | 允许连接的准确 IPv4 或 IPv6 地址。 |

IPv4 映射地址会统一格式，IPv6 回环地址 `::1` 会按 `127.0.0.1` 处理。上游地址由 DSH 自身提供，不能通过插件配置改到其他服务。如果内部 DSH Web 服务没有绑定 `127.0.0.1`，插件会拒绝启动。

白名单内的监控服务可请求 `GET /_dsh-remote-gateway/health`。它不访问 DSH 上游，直接返回 `200 ok`，因此检查的是网关进程与来源策略，而不是 DSH 就绪状态。

@jiachi/dsh-remote-gateway README · 安全模型：- TLS 和用户认证在反向代理结束；
- 网关只应放行反向代理的局域网地址；
- 内部 DSH Web 服务保持回环监听；
- 转发上游前移除 `Authorization`、`Proxy-Authorization`、`Forwarded`、`X-Forwarded-*` 和 `X-Real-IP`；
- 来源 IP 白名单无法防御已经被攻陷的反向代理，也无法区分共享同一来源地址的设备；
- DSH 插件拥有 DSH 进程自身的权限，安装第三方插件前仍需审阅代码。

安全问题报告和部署建议见 [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)。

@jiachi/dsh-remote-gateway README · 兼容性：| 组件 | 状态 |
| --- | --- |
| DSH `0.1.1-rc.2` | 已于 2026-08-28 验证 |
| HTTP 和 SSE | 已验证 |
| WebSocket Upgrade | 已验证 |
| 设置 API | 已验证 |
| 应用内宿主机目录浏览 | 已验证 |
| 已有及后续标准 Host/Client bundle | 除连接模块精确路径外均原样透传 |

连接模块补丁采用“失败即停止”策略。如果 DSH 更新改变目标探针，该模块会返回带明确日志的 `502`，而不是静默加载一个功能残缺的远程页面。

大多数遵循同源相对路径的插件会直接工作，因为客户端资源和请求会透明转发。如果某插件硬编码 `localhost`、调用宿主机原生窗口，或自行拒绝非回环浏览器地址，仍可能需要针对该插件单独适配。

@jiachi/dsh-remote-gateway README · 更新和卸载：可在 dsh-market 更新，或通过命令行重新添加 GitHub 源，然后重启 DSH：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Jiachi5533/dsh-remote-gateway
```

卸载：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove @jiachi/dsh-remote-gateway
```

卸载后，从 profile patch 中删除本插件添加且仍残留的 `remote-gateway`、`directory-picker-browse` 和 `ui-directory-picker-browse` 配置行，再重启 DSH。

@jiachi/dsh-remote-gateway README · 常见问题：- `403 forbidden`：TCP 来源地址不在 `allowedSources`；应添加反向代理的局域网 IP，不是远程浏览器的公网 IP。
- `502 ... compatibility probe matched 0 times`：当前 DSH 连接模块已经变化；请固定到已验证版本，或提交包含双方版本号的 issue。
- 页面能打开但 WebSocket 失败：在反向代理中启用 WebSocket Upgrade 转发。
- 仍出现原生文件夹对话框：确认两个 browse picker 配置已启用，原生 `directory-picker` 已禁用。
- 新安装的 UI 插件没有显示：安装后重启 DSH，再强制刷新浏览器。

@jiachi/dsh-remote-gateway README · 开发：```sh
npm test
```

测试覆盖来源过滤、IPv4 映射地址、信任请求头改写、连接模块失败保护，以及无关插件 bundle 的逐字节透传。
